2:120.text: And never will the Jews and the Christians approve of you until you follow their religion. Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allāh is the
guidance." If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allāh no protector or helper.

2:121.text: Those to whom We have given the Book recite it with its true recital.
believe in it. And whoever disbelieves in it - it is they who are the losers.

2:122.text: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.

2:123.text: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul
at all, and no compensation will be accepted from it, nor will any intercession benefit it, nor will they be aided.

2:124.text: , when Abraham was tried by his Lord with words
said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people."
said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."

2:126.text: when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allāh and the Last Day."
said, "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination."
